title: GeoNerd: AI visibility digest for UK accountancy practices

problem_severity_frequency.rationale: AIO/YMYL exposure is documented and the shared-question structure is coherent, but no target buyer has confirmed the problem is felt or frequent (assumption A2).

buyer_budget_clarity.rationale: Buyer and decision maker are precisely identified (1-20 staff practice owner/partner); budget authority is plausible but no observed willingness to pay exists (assumption A1).

evidence_strength.rationale: All evidence is internal desk research with secondary sources; coherent and specific, but no independent or buyer-derived evidence. No material claim rises above medium confidence.

distribution.rationale: Named non-paid channels exist (communities, directories, SEO, benchmark report) but no yield has been measured (assumption A4).

differentiation.rationale: Vertical depth + honest measurement + plain-language actions is a real angle, but TendorAI contests the same vertical and SearchScore undercuts on price; wedge unproven against buyers.

validation_speed_cost.rationale: A 1-week, £50, 20 human-hour test with a pre-fixed mechanical decision rule exists and directly targets the central assumption.

feasibility.rationale: Manual scan is straightforward; the technical uncertainty (UI vs API equivalence) is bounded and deferred to the measurement bake-off rather than blocking the demand test.

economics.rationale: Modelled contribution is positive at >=10 customers per market at £19.99/mo with plausible cost ranges; the cost model is untested against a real provider bill (assumption A5).

founder_fit.rationale: No evidence recorded about the founder's domain access, distribution or time budget beyond the existence of the GeoNerd research repo; left unscored rather than guessed.

risk.rationale: No regulated personal data or platform-risk story, but incumbent contest and dependency on third-party AI surfaces are material and unresolved.

economic_buyer.note: Practice owner/partner is the decision maker; £19.99/mo is a small purchase against the value of one client.

painful_frequent_or_budgeted.note: Assumed painful and recurring by analogy with search visibility tracking; desk evidence only (assumption A2).

non_paid_distribution.note: Directory outreach, professional communities, SEO and a benchmark report are credible non-paid routes (assumption A4).

defensible_wedge.note: Vertical depth + honest measurement + plain-language actions versus free checkers and £299/mo done-for-you services.

no_network_effects_needed.note: Market-level prompt set is usable by a single customer; benchmarks improve with density but are not required for value.

plausible_margins.note: Modelled contribution positive at >=10 customers per market at £19.99/mo; cost model untested.

acceptable_risk.note: No personal data beyond submitted email; claims about AI answers are reproducible and disclaimered.

cheap_disconfirming_test.note: £50 / 20 human-hours / 1-week demand spike with a pre-fixed decision rule can falsify the central assumption.

not_all_optimistic.note: Stop rules fire on 0/5 commitments and on incumbent satisfaction; iterate path is defined.

history.reason: Bootstrap seed at validation-ready under issue #1; independent review requested because the idea is proposed at an advanced state.
